questions.stem: A 45-year-old woman presents with a feeling of nervousness and has abdominal pain and diarrhoea. She has had a history of heartburn, and indigestion for the past 25 years. She gives similar complaints in the family of being “tense and nervous”. What other symptoms might you expect to see in this condition?
